newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan retail gasoline, gas oil prices down-survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan retail gasoline, gas oil prices down-survey.

text.p: Japan's average gasoline and gas oil prices at the pump stood at 104 yen and 82 yen, respectively, as of June 10, with both down one yen per litre from the previous month, a research body said on Monday.
The slip in retail prices can be attributed to a fierce price war waged among gasoline stations as well as lower wholesale prices for June, an official for the Oil Information Service Centre said.

Most major oil firms in Japan, including Nippon Oil Co Ltd and Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd, have slashed their wholesale prices for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene by about one yen per litre as of June 1, reflecting lower prices for April-lifting crude oil.
The average kerosene price at the retail level was 50 yen per litre as of June 10, unchanged from the previous month despite the cut in wholesale prices.
